description: $0.01 via x402: Satellite snapshot (PNG) of the area around lat,lon on a date: NASA GIBS true-color imagery (MODIS Terra by default; VIIRS, Aqua and false-colour bands 7-2-1 on request), km half-width 2 to 500, up to 1024 px. For agents that watch places: ports, farms, fires, floods, construction, shipping. Pay 0.01 USDC per snapshot through https://store.agentexchange.work/gw/earth/snapshot. Via the Agent Exchan

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default yesterday UTC; MODIS and VIIRS imagery lags about a day)

km.description: half-width of the view in km, 2..500 (default 20)

x_payment.description: Signed x402 payment payload (optional; without it the answer is the price)

name: earth_snapshot
